summary.headline: GREEN PLUS amends KRW 10bn convertible bond issue; maturity and payment dates pushed to Dec 9, 2029 and Dec 9, 2026
summary.what_happened: GREEN PLUS Co., Ltd. filed a correction to its material report on a KRW 10bn private, unsecured convertible bond (6th series). The correction moves the payment date, maturity, interest and conversion dates from late November to December 9, and updates the conversion price to KRW 4,294 per share and the number of shares issuable on conversion to 2,328,830. The board resolution date is now recorded as Nov 25, 2026.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, corrections to convertible bond filings usually change the timing or terms of a bond issue and can affect how much new stock could be issued if holders convert, which may dilute existing shareholders. Holders' put options and conversion windows are typically tied to these dates, so shareholders generally track such corrections closely.
